**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or missing component is.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what component or feature you want to see (e.g. Vista Gadget Dock, Windows Media Player 11 Visualizer skin, Aqua audio sound pack).

**Aesthetic / Historical Reference**
Link to historical screenshots, archives (e.g. [Frutiger Aero Archive](https://frutigeraeroarchive.org)), or early Web 2.0 reference materials.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, sketches, or API design ideas here.
